en.headline: Bomb-disposal and light public housing teams win Chief Executive’s Citation List awards
en.dek: Chief Executive John Lee presented the awards at a ceremony at Government Headquarters, praising the teams for professional solidarity and innovative delivery of results.
body: Two cross-department teams — the wartime bomb disposal action and support group and the light public housing project team — received the Chief Executive’s Citation List awards at a ceremony at Government Headquarters on Friday.

The bomb-disposal team, involving the Security Bureau, police Explosive Ordnance Disposal Bureau, Fire Services Department and Home Affairs Department, was recognised for its response last September when a roughly 1,000-pound Second World War bomb was discovered at a construction site in Quarry Bay as Super Typhoon Ragasa approached. Officers evacuated nearly 3,000 residents and safely disposed of the device before the storm arrived.

Senior bomb disposal officer Li Chin-chiu of the police said the operation was among the most difficult of its kind in Hong Kong because the device lay about 30 metres from residential buildings and near commercial premises. The light public housing team from the Housing Bureau and Architectural Services Department was cited for using modular integrated construction and standardised designs to accelerate delivery of about 30,000 units, helping to shorten overall public housing waiting times.
Lee said both teams had demonstrated the civil service spirit of rising to challenges and pursuing excellence, delivering concrete results that earned public trust.

zh.headline: 行政長官表揚榜 拆彈及簡約公屋兩跨部門團隊獲獎
zh.dek: 李家超在政府總部頒獎典禮上向兩支隊伍頒發獎狀，讚揚公務員專業團結、敢於挑戰及以結果為目標的服務精神。
body: 「行政長官表揚榜」頒獎典禮周五在政府總部舉行，得獎隊伍為「處理戰時炸彈跨部門行動及支援組」以及「簡約公屋項目跨部門團隊」。
拆彈團隊由保安局、警務處爆炸品處理課、消防處及民政事務總署組成，去年九月鰂魚涌地盤發現一枚重約一千磅的二戰時期炸彈，當時超強颱風逼近，團隊疏散近三千名居民，並在風暴到達前成功拆彈。
警務處高級炸彈處理主任李展超表示，該次行動因炸彈距離民居約三十米，並鄰近商廈，屬同類處理中難度最高的一次。房屋局及建築署組成的簡約公屋團隊則因運用組裝合成建築法及標準化設計，加快興建約三萬個單位，有助縮短公屋綜合輪候時間而獲表揚。
行政長官李家超表示，兩支團隊高效履行使命，展現公務員迎難而上、追求卓越的專業精神，為整個公務員隊伍樹立典範。
